text:
amanda-cs: FYI escalation from @Acme — since 06:20 UTC they're seeing large numbers of 429s and tail latency spikes (5-8s) on Dedicated NA-west. Placement failures and requests queued. Customer says behaviour started after a traffic burst. Billing/auth look fine. Escalating to infra.
sophie-oncall: on it — can you paste the customer id + ticket link and a short repro? severity? :eyes:
amanda-cs: cust=acme-inc, ticket=https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/INC-12457, severity=high (customer-facing API timeouts). Repro steps from them: 25 concurrent sessions -> consistent 429s after ~30s of steady traffic.
raj-eng: thanks. initial hypothesis: regional GPU stockout / warmup throttle preventing autoscale from adding capacity. need allocator + autoscaler logs for NA-west for the 06:15–06:30 window. also tenant id and pool assignment pls.
amanda-cs: tenant=acme-42, pool=dedicated-na-west-48g. attaching customer's minimal repro curl they gave.
amanda-cs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/session \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-3.8x-ded","prompt":"ping","max_tokens":16}' &
# run 25 of these in parallel
```
devin-platform: pulling allocator/autoscaler metrics now. Quick note: the autoscaler has a warmup_cooldown of 300s and an aggressive warmup_throttle for GPUs to avoid noisy-tenant thrash. If multiple scale actions triggered at once, throttle can deny additional nodes until warmup completes.
marie-sre: pasting relevant logs from allocator (06:16:02–06:24:15):
```text
[06:16:02] placement_request tenant=acme-42 size=2 -> denied: capacity_shortfall
[06:16:03] allocator: queue_len=27, inflight=4
[06:17:10] autoscaler: scale_up candidate nodes=2 -> suppressed: warmup_throttle_active
[06:18:05] placement_request tenant=acme-42 size=2 -> rate_limited: warmup_throttle
[06:20:30] allocator: eviction_suggestion tenant=other-tenant reason=noisy_neighbor
[06:22:01] autoscaler: backoff until 06:27:01 (cooldown)
```
alloc-bot: Automated alert: 180 placement failures in pool dedicated-na-west-48g between 06:15 and 06:25 UTC. Related tickets: INC-12457.
raj-eng: noisy_neighbor evidence at 06:20 (eviction_suggestion). Looks like the autoscaler suppressed scale actions because we hit warmup throttle after a previous noisy tenant caused eviction attempts. That left insufficient spare capacity so acme's concurrent sessions hit placement failures.
devin-platform: suggested mitigation plan:
- temporarily relax warmup_throttle for pool `dedicated-na-west-48g` (allow +3 nodes immediate) :white_check_mark:
- kick prewarm backfill for acme-42 via pool reserver
- route acme-42 traffic fallback to NA-east until warmup completes (gradual failover)
- post-incident: adjust warmup_cooldown logic to consider tenant SLAs
sophie-oncall: do we have runbook commands? need to run them now and capture steps for postmortem.
devin-platform: runbook fragment (PATCH to cluster-config service):
```bash
# relax warmup throttle
curl -X PATCH https://internal.redwood.ai/cluster-config/pools/dedicated-na-west-48g \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"warmup_throttle":{"enabled":false,"temp_override_until":"2026-03-17T07:00:00Z"}}'

# request immediate prewarm nodes
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.ai/autoscaler/prewarm \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"pool":"dedicated-na-west-48g","count":3,"reason":"incident INC-12457 acme fallback"}'
```
marie-sre: I'll run the prewarm and monitor allocator. sophie — I'll also trigger routing policy to failover acme-42 to NA-east with 10% traffic shift first.
amanda-cs: I informed the customer about an interim failover to NA-east and asked them to confirm tolerance for a 100–200ms RTT increase. They accepted fallback for the duration.
console-bot: Config patch applied by devin-platform at 06:28 UTC. Prewarm request accepted (job id prewarm-8892). Routing policy update staged.
raj-eng: after prewarm we should see placement failures drop. key action items: (1) audit warmup_throttle triggers and ensure noisy-tenant eviction doesn't permanently suppress scale, (2) add SLA-aware bypass for critical customers, (3) add metric knob for short emergency overrides.
sophie-oncall: assigning owners: devin=implement emergency override + runbook, raj=postmortem for autoscaler logic, marie=smoke tests + monitoring dashboard updates, amanda=customer comms. I'll create the incident in PagerDuty and update INC-12457.
amanda-cs: customer updated: they're seeing reduced 429s after 06:34, still monitoring. thanks team :thumbsup:
devin-platform: monitoring graphs show queue_len dropping and placement_success increasing. keeping the warmup override until 07:00 as a safe window. will revert and document exact thresholds.
marie-sre: note for postmortem: noisy_neighbor eviction at 06:20 correlated with autoscaler suppression. we should capture heap of allocator state for future debugging.
sophie-oncall: closing loop — follow-up async postmortem requested. tagging @oncall rotation for visibility. :white_check_mark:
